fusions.name: Unbent Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 34 damage and ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Rim Swing
fusions.desc: A swing with the axe's heavy rim that deals 5 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles; each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Temper Shield
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Cold Resolve
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
